steps.label: Snapshot
steps.does: Lists the tasks parked in needs-clarification or blocked across the pipelines and groups them by normalised failure signature.

steps.label: Evidence pack
steps.does: Runs the fixed checks on the chosen task (original exists, cited paths, known fix applies, replay, sibling count) and writes facts only.

steps.label: Classify
steps.does: The one judgement: picks one of five outcomes from the evidence pack; a validator rejects anything outside the list.

steps.label: Act
steps.does: Archives, requeues or files the mechanism task and appends the ledger line.

steps.label: Draft mechanism task
steps.does: Only for ESCALATE-MECHANISM: writes the task text of the filing from the bucket evidence.

steps.label: Index
steps.does: Lists the unverified agent branches across the pooled projects.

steps.label: Evidence pack
steps.does: Scratch worktree, changed files, conflict check, suite on the branch against a clean base, hub context, redundancy.

steps.label: Decide
steps.does: Picks merge, needs-work, hold or discard from named facts in a fixed order. No model call (the planned model step is not built).

steps.label: Record
steps.does: Writes the verdict through the dashboard verdict route (dry-run by default) after a write-ahead ledger line.

steps.label: Index
steps.does: Lists the Needs-Work branches across pooled projects with reason, verdict source and age.

steps.label: Evidence pack
steps.does: Task lookup, rivals, candidate check result and the reason signature count.

steps.label: Decide
steps.does: Picks one of six outcomes by named facts in a fixed precedence. No model call.

steps.label: Act
steps.does: Records a verdict, requeues or files through the existing dashboard routes (dry-run by default).

steps.label: Index
steps.does: Lists held hubs joined to their records and the first unbuilt piece.

steps.label: Evidence pack
steps.does: State and age of the first open piece, the hub branch judgement, abandoned pieces.

steps.label: Decide
steps.does: Picks in flight, superseded, abandoned-only or hold by a fixed precedence. No model call.

steps.label: Act
steps.does: Retires the hub or adds a piece through the hub routes (dry-run by default).

steps.label: Index
steps.does: Lists the pooled projects with their checkout, branch and origin sha.

steps.label: Evidence pack
steps.does: Checkout state, baseline, cached poll-detector scan and open filings.

steps.label: Decide
steps.does: Picks one of six outcomes (not on main, scan failed, no baseline, nothing new, too many, file). No model call.

steps.label: Act
steps.does: Files one task through queueAdhocTask or runs the detector baseline (dry-run by default).

steps.label: Index
steps.does: Lists candidate branches with their judged head sha.

steps.label: Evidence pack
steps.does: Git facts from origin objects, the verdict, whether the branch equals the reviewed diff.

steps.label: Decide
steps.does: Picks one of five outcomes by named facts. No model call.

steps.label: Act
steps.does: Posts one verdict request to the dashboard (dry-run by default).

steps.label: Candidates
steps.does: Reads the candidates from the checker ledger.

steps.label: Evidence pack
steps.does: Checker row, listing row, remote proof, running merges and the worker own recent merges.

steps.label: Decide
steps.does: Picks merge, wait, drop or already merged by a fixed precedence. No model call.

steps.label: Merge
steps.does: Sends one request to the dashboard merge route and proves the result on the remote.

steps.label: Slot
steps.does: Reads the current idle-cost audit slot.

steps.label: Evidence pack
steps.does: The audit of the slot, the earlier audit, the rises per originator and whether the worst was filed.

steps.label: Decide
steps.does: Picks one of five outcomes by named facts. No model call.

steps.label: Act
steps.does: Files one task through queueAdhocTask and writes the registry (dry-run by default).

steps.label: Watch
steps.does: Wakes when the core checkout HEAD changes.

steps.label: Citation scan
steps.does: Compares every map citation with the files and symbols at HEAD.

steps.label: Decide
steps.does: Picks FRESH, FIX-RANGES, REWRITE-ROW, SUGGEST-ANCHORS, SUGGEST-ROWS or HOLD-FOR-OWNER. No model call.

steps.label: Act
steps.does: Files one batched task when there are findings and none is open (dry-run by default).

steps.label: Watch
steps.does: Wakes when MEMORY.md or the memory directory changes.

steps.label: Lint
steps.does: Checks size, long entries, dangling links, orphans and duplicates.

steps.label: Decide
steps.does: Picks OK, OVER-BUDGET, LONG-ENTRIES, DANGLING, ORPHAN, DUPLICATE, ARCHIVE-CANDIDATES or HOLD-FOR-OWNER. No model call.

steps.label: Report
steps.does: Writes the ledger decision and a compaction proposal for a person to apply; edits no memory file.

steps.label: Watch
steps.does: Wakes when a measured channel changes.

steps.label: Measure
steps.does: Recomputes the gauge snapshot from the transcript and pipeline channels.

steps.label: Decide
steps.does: Applies the thresholds and the cooldowns to the gauges. No model call.

steps.label: Act
steps.does: Appends the snapshot and, in on mode, files a task for a breached gauge (dry-run now).

loops.name: UI conformance loop
loops.gate: UI_CONFORMANCE_MODE (off, dry-run or on) for the uiforge watchdog trigger

steps.label: Trigger
steps.does: Runs once per watchdog tick: a git rev-parse when nothing changed.

steps.label: Sweep
steps.does: Starts the detached UI conformance sweep over the configured pages.

steps.label: Apply handler
steps.does: The script lane worker-uiconf turns sweep findings into tasks.

steps.label: Index
steps.does: Maps ZIP to county to config folder and registry row.

steps.label: Evidence pack
steps.does: Registry row, validator result and, when a build is possible, a capped source probe.

steps.label: Decide
steps.does: Fixed facts first; then one judgement between NEW-CONFIG and BESPOKE-NEEDED.

steps.label: Act
steps.does: Files one premium task into the taxharvest-scrapers pipeline (dry-run by default).
